identificationModule.briefTitle: Vigamox Treatment for Ocular Graft-Versus-Host Disease
identificationModule.officialTitle: Evaluation of Topical Vigamox in the Initial Management of Ocular Graft-Versus-Host Disease

descriptionModule.briefSummary: In this study the investigators seek to prospectively measure the response of ocular graft-versus-host disease (GVHD) patients to treatment with topical Vigamox. The investigators will accomplish this by enrolling patients with bilateral ocular GVHD and treating one eye with topical Vigamox and the other eye with a placebo eye drop. By assessing the response to treatment with Vigamox, the investigators hope to identify a role for topical antibiotic treatment in ocular GVHD.

designInfo.interventionModelDescription: The eyes of each enrolled participant will be randomized such that one eye is treated with Vigamox and the other eye is treated with a placebo eye drop.

armGroups.label: Arm 1: Eye treated with Vigamox
armGroups.description: -The participant will be instructed to use one drop from each bottle four times per day for 7 days

armGroups.label: Arm 2: Eye treated with placebo
armGroups.description: -The participant will be instructed to use one drop from each bottle four times per day for 7 days

primaryOutcomes.description:
* Ocular comfort will be rated by the participant for each eye on a 0-10 Visual Analog Scale
* 0=no discomfort and 10=worst discomfort
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: First clinic visit through second clinic visit (estimated to be 9-14 days)

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Change in Ocular Surface Disease Index (OSDI) score
secondaryOutcomes.description:
* 12 questions with answers ranging from 0=none of the time to 4=all of the time
* The OSDI©is assessed on a scale of 0 to 100, with higher scores representing greater disability. The index demonstrates sensitivity and specificity in distinguishing between normal subjects and patients with dry eye disease.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Change in the Degree of Conjunctival injection
secondaryOutcomes.description: -The degree of conjunctival injection will be graded based on the Validated Bulbar Redness scale
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: First clinic visit through second clinic visit (estimated to be 9-14 days)

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Change in Corneal/conjunctival punctate epithelial erosions
secondaryOutcomes.description:
* The clinical exam will be conducted using the National Eye Institute Fluorescein Staining Scale to grade the degree of corneal and conjunctival stain with a cobalt blue slit lamp filter
* This test divides the cornea into 5 sections. Staining is graded on a scale of 0-3, with 0 indicating absence of staining and 3 indicating severe staining.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: First clinic visit through second clinic visit (estimated to be 9-14 days)

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

-Participants will be adults with a history of allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation, signs of either acute or chronic GVHD per the hematologist, signs and symptoms consistent with ocular GVHD + within 4 months of developing symptoms of ocular GVHD

Exclusion Criteria:

* Treated with antibiotic eye drops in the month prior to enrollment
* History of fluoroquinolone allergy
* Asymmetric ocular disease
* Pregnant
* Nursing
